title: Shadows to.......
text:
I was looking at how shadows could relate to the possible idea of a cafe. 
What comes to mind when you think of shadows? darkness, scared, horrior.
Obviously these things didnt work very well with the brief unless we wanted to make a haunted house. 
I begun to draw a few sketches to see how shadows could have an effect in the space and how it would interact with communities.
